licence_note: The source project describes the licence in the future tense and the published archives contain no licence text. Private personal use does not trigger CC BY-SA's ShareAlike condition, because that condition attaches on distribution and nothing is distributed. That makes private use low-risk; it does not make the licence verified, and it is not recorded as verified here.
